description: Airport Monthly Traffic Reports is a dataset listed in City of Colorado Springs open data portal (data.coloradosprings.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Colorado Springs. This data set is retrieved from COS Airport - Air Service Development. Coverage: Colorado Springs. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: Josh  MacCammon, Air Service Development Analyst II. The portal shows 2022-11-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-coloradosprings-gov-portal.
